title: Husband, wife 45: flashing lights, numb hand, headache, 'her usual migraine'

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 915 Clayton Street. It's my wife, she's 45.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She started seeing flashing lights, then her right hand went numb, and now she has a bad headache.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Has she had anything like this before?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She gets migraines. She says it's her usual migraine but worse this time.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Did it come on all at once or slowly?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Slowly. The lights came first and the numbness kind of crept up over twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was she last completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About an hour ago, before the lights started, she was fine.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Let her rest somewhere dark and quiet.
